import numpy as np, json, os
from scipy import ndimage
def transform(grid):
    a=np.array(grid)
    mask=a!=0
    lab,n=ndimage.label(mask)
    # component containing a 1 (background color 1)
    ones=np.argwhere(a==1)
    if len(ones)==0:
        comp=max(range(1,n+1),key=lambda k:(lab==k).sum())
    else:
        comp=lab[ones[0][0],ones[0][1]]
    ys,xs=np.where(lab==comp)
    blk=a[ys.min():ys.max()+1,xs.min():xs.max()+1]
    return np.fliplr(np.rot90(blk)).tolist()
